05 · FAQ

Before you message us

Which learners do you teach?

Grade 10, Grade 12 and matric rewrite learners, in Mathematics only. We don't teach Maths Literacy, and we don't currently teach Grade 11.

How big are the groups?

No more than 10 learners in each online group, 15 in the Saturday class, and 20 in the bootcamp. That is small enough for every learner to be seen and heard.

How do monthly payments work?

Monthly programmes take ten payments in advance on the 1st, January to October, by card subscription, or by Instant EFT or Capitec Pay against a monthly payment link. Second Chances is four payments per intake. Paying a full term up front earns 10% off.

How do I stop monthly billing?

Message us on WhatsApp or email us before the 25th of the month, and the next month's debit will not be taken. There are no partial-month refunds.

Do I pay a card fee?

No. Our prices include card fees, and there is no card surcharge at checkout. Card details are entered only on Paystack's secure checkout, never over WhatsApp or on this website.

When can I enrol and pay?

The waitlist is open now. Paid enrolment opens on 1 December 2026, and the first sessions run in the week of 1 February 2027.

Is Second Chances the free government programme?

No. GeniusEdge's Second Chances Programme is a private, paid programme, separate from the free Second Chance Matric Programme run by the Department of Basic Education.

Where are you based?

Johannesburg. Online classes are open to learners anywhere in South Africa, and the Saturday class is held in person in Johannesburg.
